location.title: Location Convenience:
location.body: Guests highlight proximity to subway stations, Lujiazui, The Bund, and central sightseeing.

facilities.title: New and Smart Facilities:
facilities.body: Many reviews mention recent renovations, in-room smart assistants, and modern equipment.

service.title: Good Service:
service.body: Front desk staff are described as friendly and responsive; some guests mention robot food delivery.

hygiene.title: Clean Hygiene:
hygiene.body: Rooms are frequently described as clean with prompt housekeeping.

environment.title: Comfortable Environment:
environment.body: Guests appreciate minimalist decor, natural light where available, and good ventilation.

suggestion.title: Guest Suggestion:
suggestion.body: A smaller number of reviews cite bedding comfort, street or renovation noise, and air quality as areas to improve.

chalermpan.name: Chalermpan Zu
chalermpan.body: We were surprised by the entrance which was under construction, we couldn't even find the hotel sign although we were standing in front of it. After reaching the hotel lobby on the fifth floor, the cigarette smell was dense though inside our room was minimal. After going out for the whole evening, the cigarette smell was intense in our room. The good things were the room size and the bed, including cleanliness and staff's attentive service.

liona.name: liona777
liona.body: Environment: There's ongoing renovation downstairs from 8 AM to 6 PM, and the noise is very loud and can be heard in every room. The rooms have no windows, and the newly renovated smell is quite strong. With no windows, the smell can't dissipate, making my throat feel scratchy after just one night. It's about a ten-minute walk to Century Avenue Metro Station, but quite close to the Bund by taxi.

guest.name: Guest User
guest.body: The room was very clean and odor-free. I compared reviews for several Home Inn branches, and this one was the only one without hygiene issues. After staying, it was indeed as good as the reviews claimed; even the bathroom was spotless. Because there was noise from renovations on other floors, the front desk staff immediately moved me to another room and kept checking to see if the situation had improved. You can really feel their dedication to solving customer problems. It's this servic...

WhyBook.title: Why Book Flights with Trip.com
WhyBook.flightsToSuitYouText: Ready to jet off? Booking a flight is the first step to an exciting getaway. WhyBook.flightsToSuitYouTextExpanded: Ready to jet off? Booking a flight is the first step to an exciting getaway. However, with so many things to consider, finding cheap flights is not always the easiest of tasks. That's why, at Trip.com, we've made things simple. Letting you search and compare flights from thousands of different airlines to destinations all over the world, it's never been easier to find flight tickets to suit you. From economy to first-class airline tickets, direct to connecting flights and return and one-way tickets, you can filter your search to suit your plans and budget. Whether it's for a long-haul family holiday, romantic weekend break, or a professional business trip, in just a few clicks you can be on your way to your chosen destination.
WhyBook.bookCheapText: There are plenty of other ways you can save money on flights, too. You can look out for our flight flash sales, sign up to price alerts which let you know when flight prices have dropped, and download the Trip.com app to get money off. Joining the Trip.com loyalty program also gives you access to exclusive member-only offers. Not only that, but you can also earn Trip Coins which can be redeemed on your next booking.

HowToBook.title: How to Book Cheap Flights?
HowToBook.item1Content: Opting to take your flight during the working week can save you money. Flights departing over this period - especially Tuesdays and Wednesdays - are cheaper, mainly because these days are less popular to travel on.
HowToBook.item2Title: Have a look at airline websites
HowToBook.item2Content: Many airline websites have made it simpler to identify the inexpensive days to fly by displaying a "calendar view" booking system. This system allows you to scan prices ranging across the week that you are searching.
HowToBook.item3Title: Consider flights with less-popular departure times
HowToBook.item3Content: You may also get a bargain flight if you're willing to fly at an early hour. It may well be less expensive to fly at 6 am than at later times due to that time spot being less popular. The only problem you could face is getting to the airport at this time; make sure that public transport is running if you can't take a taxi or get a lift to the airport.
HowToBook.item4Title: Find a better price on the Trip.com app
HowToBook.item4Content: This may sound like I'm stating the obvious, but you'd be surprised at the number of people who settle for a price without first shopping around and doing some research. We suggest you have a look for bargains on the Trip.com app.
HowToBook.item5Title: Book early instead of waiting until the last minute
HowToBook.item5Content: Don't get fooled into thinking that last-minute deals are necessarily the best option for cheap flight tickets because they seldom are. The smart move is to book early, even as far as a year in advance if that is possible for the flight you require. Flight tickets have a tendency to be cheaper when they are first released - which is normally about a year before the flight - so have a look online as soon as the flights you want are available.
HowToBook.item6Title: Use a credit card in a wiser way
HowToBook.item6Content: There are a lot of advantages to paying for a flight with a credit card. One advantage is that you are protected when you make bigger purchases. Certain credit cards will offer you air miles for each sum of money spent, thus saving you a bit more on your flight tickets.
HowToBook.item7Content: Connecting flights can often be much cheaper than direct flights. If your schedule allows, compare one-stop options and you may find major savings while still arriving comfortably at your destination.
HowToBook.item8Title: Book package holidays which may offer cheap flight tickets
HowToBook.item8Content: A package deal can sometimes reduce the total cost of your flight and accommodation. Keep an eye on package offers, especially during seasonal promotions and flash sales.
HowToBook.item9Title: Be aware of hidden costs of cheap flights
HowToBook.item9Content: Before booking, check baggage policies, seat selection charges, and airport transfer costs. A low fare can quickly increase with extras, so always compare the final total price.
